name: labs/t--wagner__pymeasure
title: Keithley 2000 multimeter
intro: Keithley 2000 multimeter, adapted from t--wagner/pymeasure. It reads `identification`, `voltage_dc`, `current_dc` and `resistance`; sets `voltage_range`; runs `measure_voltage`, `measure_current` and `measure_resistance`. `measure_voltage`: measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/t--wagner__pymeasure --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/t--wagner__pymeasure --backend fake --mcp
